note: Manual, interactive session in the Claude Code built-in browser pane against the retained vems-audit-147 stack (http://127.0.0.1:18080). This is the first actual browser UI evidence gathered for #147/#148; every prior audit recorded browser access as unavailable.

blockingIssueFound.summary: Every custom module's List view was a fatal PHP error for every account, administrator included, because vtlib module creation never ships a default "All" custom view row.
blockingIssueFound.detail: CustomView::getViewId() selects `cvid FROM vtiger_customview WHERE viewname='All' AND entitytype=?`; with no matching row the resolved view id was empty, and ListViewContents.tpl fatally called isCvEditable() on a null custom-view object.
blockingIssueFound.fix: provision-development.php now inserts one default view per module (viewname=All, setdefault=1, setmetrics=0, status=0, userid=1), matching the exact shape of a standard module's system "All" view (verified against the shipped Leads/Accounts rows). Idempotent; applies to vems-dev too, not just the audit stack.
blockingIssueFound.scopeNote: This is baseline List-view functionality, not the saved-filter/related-list/menu design that #151 ("PR 4 - Lists, roles and navigation") owns.

accountsCreated.note: provision-audit-roles.php (audit-only; not part of provision-development.php or vems-dev). Grants viewall=on/editall=off per profile; explicit per-tab action/field denial. See docs/vtiger/OWNERSHIP_AND_COMMANDS.md.

knownResidualFindings.summary: Custom module list views (VEMSVehicles, VEMSStockItems, etc.) render rows with blank/empty column text.
knownResidualFindings.cause: No vtiger_cvcolumnlist entries exist for the generated default view; the module PHP class's list_fields/list_fields_name declare only External Key and Assigned To.
knownResidualFindings.scope: #151 ("Lists, roles and navigation") owns saved filters, column configuration and menu design; this audit only fixed the fatal-error blocker, not the column display.

knownResidualFindings.summary: PHP warnings appear on several pages for non-administrator accounts (e.g. "Undefined array key 4/6/7/8/9/14/15/18/19" in Privileges.php on the dashboard for the new profiles; "Undefined array key 51" in UserInfoUtil.php for the pre-existing integration account; "Undefined array key DETAILVIEWBASIC" in DetailViewActions.tpl for a profile with edit denied).
knownResidualFindings.cause: Vtiger's permission-check code reads array offsets for action/utility ids without isset() guards; this triggers whenever a profile does not explicitly grant every id the page happens to check. provision-audit-roles.php now explicitly denies every id Vtiger_Action_Model::getAll(true) returns for each module, which eliminated most but not all instances.
knownResidualFindings.scope: Cosmetic (E_WARNING, not fatal); pages still render correct data and correct denials underneath. Not fixed further here; flagged for #151 or a dedicated cleanup.
